notes.title: v1.2 UPDATE!
notes.content:
Pandemic Panic! v1.2 is now available!

Contains fixes and tweaks to gameplay.

Thanks to all those who let us know about the bugs ːsteamhappyː

Main hitters:

On controller disconnect, keyboard/mouse would stop and wait for controller reconnection - fixed.
Tearing during main gameplay on some setups - fixed.
Occasional Buglyn would block the path - fixed.
Tougher Buglyns tweaked to match others.
Audio glitch during gameplay - fixed.
Achievements updated to match unlocks.

Watch out for the Halloween update coming soon!

That's all for now,

Zen

Why not join us on us the Scathe Discord and chat about Pandemic Panic! and what you want to see next! discord.gg/AFk2qX3
